name: shaman
_comment: v22 Shaman: the staff (shaft + mushroom cap) is one surface with the body: the shaft's back is fused into the left edge of the beard/cloak from z ~0.74 to 1.17 and the cap rim touches the hood at x -0.11, z 1.26-1.30 (z/x sections). The staff is RIPPED out: flood-filled from the shaft (inside a capsule round its axis + a sphere round the cap, gated by its own colours: brown shaft/gills, green cap top), the thin band of faces mixing staff and body vertices deleted, and both sides' open strips ear-clip-filled from their rings. Nothing is regenerated: the original staff and cap geometry/texture are kept. Native coords of shaman_prepped.glb (prep_mesh --no-ground-sheet, eye-painted by eyefix/eyepaint.py).
